name: How can a real estate agent help me meet the 180-day 1031 exchange deadline?

mainEntity.name: How can a real estate agent help me meet the 180-day 1031 exchange deadline?

acceptedAnswer.text: A knowledgeable real estate agent can be invaluable in helping you meet the 180-day 1031 exchange deadline by streamlining the search and acquisition process. They can leverage their market expertise to quickly identify suitable like-kind properties, negotiate favorable terms, and coordinate with all parties to ensure a timely closing. For clients of Kelby Contreras in competitive markets such as Miami Beach or Brickell, an agent’s local insight and network are essential for navigating available inventory and accelerating transactions to comply with the strict timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: A real estate agent assists by quickly identifying suitable properties, negotiating terms, and coordinating timely closings to help meet the 180-day deadline.
